About Me

Building the web, one site at a time

I'm a WordPress Developer with 3+ years of web development experience and 1+ year specialized in WordPress. I build across the full range — from Elementor-based sites and WooCommerce stores to fully custom PHP themes.

My background covers strong frontend development and solid WordPress backend knowledge — hooks, filters, custom post types, and the REST API. I've also explored backend development with Python (Django, Flask).

Currently studying Information Technology at Syrian Virtual University. I competed in university-level competitive programming — problem solving is core to how I approach development.
